About WandorOriginal design ↗
Questions before you wander?

Does this use AI or book a trip?

No. This standalone template turns your notes into an editable example draft. It does not connect to AI, verify travel details, make reservations or charge you.

Where are my notes saved?

Only in this page until you reload. Use Download itinerary to keep a plain-text copy on your device.

About this template

Reference-led reconstruction of Harshit’s Wandor design with original generated illustrations and newly authored motion. Product copy and dashboard content are illustrative. All controls operate locally; no accounts, booking or real-time services are connected.
